title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam: The Landing and the Buildup, 1965
citation: Jack Shulimson and Charles M. Johnson, U.S. Marines in Vietnam: The Landing and the Buildup, 1965 (Washington, D.C.: History and Museums Division, Headquarters, U.S. Marine Corps, 1978).
notes: Official U.S. Marine Corps historical series volume. Documents the 9th Marine Expeditionary Brigade landing at Da Nang on March 8, 1965.
